items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: She said, 'Well, I'll stand responsible for the money.' They had to pay. That ain't no joke, that's really the facts.

ctx.x: That's $1,400.00. So he said, 'I'm sorry lady, if you want to make it good, you can't do that to me.' (Unintelligible). Give us a check or do something about it. Some way or another, she did, Miss Barnett. She said, 'Well, I'll stand responsible for the money.' They had to pay. That ain't no joke, that's really the facts.
Uh-uh. Right. That's what we want to get. How did you enjoy working with Joe Oliver?
